about: Golden evaluation cases for Claim Sense. Expected values are worked out by hand from the synthetic policy wording and terms (data/policies), not copied from system output. Run: python scripts/evaluate.py

claims.title: Gastroenteritis admission, every check passes; only the deductible and co-pay apply
claims.working: 25,000 billed; room rent 4,000/day is within the 5,000 limit (2.2); deductible 5,000 (5.1) -> 20,000; co-pay 10% (5.2) = 2,000 -> 18,000.

claims.title: Motor claim with a positive breath analyser test
claims.working: Police report says the driver was under the influence of alcohol; exclusion 3.1 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Cataract surgery inside the 24-month specified-disease waiting period
claims.working: Policy started 2025-02-10, surgery 2025-09-05, about 6 months of cover; cataract needs 24 months (3.3).

claims.title: Appendicectomy with a room above the per-day limit and non-payable consumables
claims.working: 106,600 billed; consumables 3,400 not payable (4.3); room 3 days x (6,500 - 5,000) = 4,500 over the limit (2.2); deductible 5,000; co-pay 10% of 93,700 = 9,370 -> 84,330.

claims.title: Motor rear-end collision with depreciation by part type and vehicle age
claims.working: 73,500 billed; vehicle 34 months old so metal 15%: bumper 50% of 12,000 = 6,000, boot lid 15% of 26,000 = 3,900, tail lamp 50% of 6,500 = 3,250, paint 50% of 6,000 = 3,000 (2.2); glass and labour 0%; 1197cc deductible 2,000 (2.3) -> 55,350.

claims.title: Dengue admission without a discharge summary
claims.working: Required documents (6.2) include the discharge summary, which is missing. Provisional amount: 43,400 - 5,000 = 38,400, co-pay 3,840 -> 34,560.

claims.title: ICU pneumonia claim: early, 94% of the sum insured, and the form amount differs from the bill
Fracture before 2025-04-01, so the older wording's lower room limit and higher deductible apply
Road accident with bills above the sum insured; payment capped at the available sum insured
claims.working: 410,000 billed; room and ICU at exactly their limits; deductible 5,000 -> 405,000; co-pay 40,500 -> 364,500; capped at the 300,000 sum insured (5.3). 410,000 / 300,000 is above 80%, the only risk signal (score 30, MEDIUM).

claims.title: Second claim for the same appendicitis admission
claims.working: Same policy, incident date and amount as CLM-H-1001, which was filed first.

claims.title: Admission on 2025-04-01, the first day of the 2025.1 wording
Same bill admitted on 2025-03-31, the last day of the 2024.1 wording
Home fire loss with contents depreciation and the average clause for underinsurance
claims.working: 450,000 assessed; depreciation 20% on refrigerator 58,000 and microwave 14,000 (11,600 + 2,800) and 10% on sofa set 66,000 (6,600) = 21,000 (2.2) -> 429,000; value at risk 30,00,000 exceeds sum insured 25,00,000 by 20%, more than 15%, so average applies (2.3): 429,000 x 25/30 = 357,500, a cut of 71,500; excess 10,000 (4.1) -> 347,500.

claims.title: Burglary with unscheduled jewellery, electronics depreciation and the excess
claims.working: 305,000 assessed; gold jewellery 140,000 not covered unless scheduled (3.5) -> 165,000; depreciation 20% on laptop 85,000 and television 62,000 = 17,000 + 12,400 = 29,400 (2.2) -> 135,600; value at risk 11,00,000 is below the 12,00,000 sum insured, no average; excess 10,000 -> 125,600. FIR present as 5.2 requires for burglary.

claims.title: Home damage from long-term seepage and gradual deterioration
claims.working: Surveyor attributes the damage to seepage and gradual deterioration of waterproofing; exclusion 3.1 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Emergency appendicectomy abroad with personal comfort items
claims.working: 442,500 billed in Singapore during the trip 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-20 (1.3); telephone and toiletries 3,500 not payable (2.4) -> 439,000; deductible 5,000 (4.1) -> 434,000; well within the 40,00,000 sum insured. Medical report present as 5.2 requires.

claims.title: Lost checked baggage above the per-item and per-trip limits
Ankle fracture from paragliding abroad
claims.working: Injury sustained while paragliding; hazardous sports exclusion 3.2 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Baggage claim without the airline's property irregularity report
claims.working: 5.2 requires the airline's property irregularity report for a baggage claim and none was uploaded; the assessable amount would be 43,000 - 5,000 deductible = 38,000, but information is requested first.

claims.title: Storm damage to the roof; only the excess applies
claims.working: 71,000 of building repairs, no depreciation on building repairs (2.2); value at risk 16,00,000 is below the 18,00,000 sum insured; excess 10,000 (4.1) -> 61,000.

claims.title: Trip cancelled by an airport closure, above the cancellation limit
claims.working: Non-refundable airfare 112,000 + hotel 68,000 = 180,000; trip cancellation limit 1,50,000 (2.2) -> 150,000; deductible 5,000 -> 145,000.

claims.title: Treatment three days after the insured trip ended
claims.working: Trip 2026-02-02 to 2026-02-09; treatment on 2026-02-12 is after the return date, outside the period of cover (1.3), although the annual policy is in force.

claims.title: Caesarean delivery under the maternity exclusion
claims.working: Discharge summary records a full term pregnancy delivered by caesarean section; maternity and childbirth are excluded (4.4), nothing is payable.

claims.title: Motor accident with the driver's licence expired
claims.working: Police report records that the driver's licence expired on 2024-12-31, before the accident on 2025-10-03; exclusion 3.2 applies, nothing is payable.

claims.title: Burglary while the home had been unoccupied for about 95 days
claims.working: Surveyor records the premises unoccupied for about 95 days, more than the 60 consecutive days in 3.3; the burglary is not payable.

claims.title: Heart condition abroad that was under treatment before departure
claims.working: Claim form and medical report describe coronary artery disease under treatment before departure; pre-existing conditions are excluded (3.1), nothing is payable.
